about_short_description.short_description: Hindsight provides a cookie-less monetization platform for advertisers and publishers.

product.name: InCERT
product.description: A contextual monetization platform that replaces cookie-based revenues with native contextual experiences to enhance reader engagement and monetization for publishers and advertisers.

product.name: Dynamic Content Optimization (DCO)
product.description: A technology that automates adaptive ad creatives to align advertising messages with the content context, improving campaign engagement and efficiency.

product.name: Content Recommendation Services
product.description: A system that recommends relevant content to website visitors based on their interests and page context to increase engagement and revenue for publishers.

product.name: Publisher Operations Platform
product.description: A platform that supports the management, scheduling, trafficking, optimization, and reporting of online advertising campaigns for publishers.

product.name: Data Monetization Solutions
product.description: Tools and services that help publishers activate, manage, and monetize audience data for targeted advertising and increased revenue.
